content.introduction: The latest economic news releases from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics include the Employment Situation for October 2, 2026, Metropolitan Area Employment and Unemployment (Monthly) for September 30, 2026, and Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey for September 29, 2026. Major economic indicators show U.S. import prices advanced 0.7 percent in August 2026, and export prices rose 0.6 percent in August 2026. Productivity increased 1.4 percent in the nonfarm business sector in the second quarter of 2026, and unit labor costs increased 1.2 percent. The latest figures also include a 0.4 percent increase in the Producer Price Index in August 2026, a 0.9 percent rise in the Employment Cost Index in the second quarter of 2026, and a 1.4 percent productivity increase in the second quarter of 2026.

## MAJOR ECONOMIC INDICATORS

### Consumer Price Index [...] In August, U.S. import prices advanced 0.7 percent following a drop of 0.3 percent in July. U.S. export prices rose 0.6 percent in August after declining 1.4 percent in July. Over the past 12 months, import prices advanced 7.0 percent, and export prices rose 8.6 percent.
